findings.current_basis: realized historical weekly scoring dispersion with player/position shrinkage, hand-set SD floors, bounded CV fallbacks, and heuristic availability assumptions
findings.key_issue: realized cross-player or within-player score dispersion is not equivalent to conditional forecast residual uncertainty
findings.promotion_evidence: Archived point-in-time forecasts paired with realized weekly outcomes; temporal residual calibration, interval coverage, distributional scoring, and position/horizon partial pooling.

findings.key_issue: fallbacks can dominate sparse/new-player uncertainty and therefore downstream win/title tails
findings.promotion_evidence: Hierarchical residual model with posterior/shrinkage estimates by position, experience, role and forecast horizon; retain broad safety floors only if needed for coverage.

findings.current_basis: hand-set need, preference, window, endowment, depth, recent-performance, usage, injury, market-momentum and pick adjustments
findings.key_issue: many coefficients overlap market anchors, Simulator outcomes, Behavioral Intelligence or GM3 state-aware utility
findings.promotion_evidence: Only re-enable individual signals after time-ordered residual evidence demonstrates incremental value beyond canonical market/projection/simulation inputs.

findings.current_basis: median of league-relative expected-points, wins, playoff-probability and net-title-equity deltas; scaled by observed focal market-redraft value
findings.key_issue: median avoids arbitrary correlation weights and obvious double counting, but the choice of median itself is a structural aggregation prior rather than empirically established optimal mapping
findings.promotion_evidence: Compare median against simpler robust alternatives and direct Simulator marginal outcome targets; change only if held-out decision/outcome evidence demonstrates meaningful improvement without reintroducing correlated double counting.

findings.current_basis: baseline team market-redraft value, with transaction redraft exposure as compatibility fallback
findings.key_issue: data-derived and preferable to a fixed exchange-rate constant, but the economic mapping from relative Simulator movement to redraft-market units remains an anchoring choice
findings.promotion_evidence: Validate stability across teams/seasons and compare against observed marginal roster redraft replacement scales; avoid introducing a new hand-set position multiplier.

findings.current_basis: value-denominated GM3 residual channels that can be structurally disabled; duplicate pair-insurance and acceptance mappings are disabled
findings.key_issue: incremental identifiability beyond future value and Simulator replacement resilience is not yet demonstrated
findings.promotion_evidence: Ablations against current/future-only baseline using independent future outcomes. If no stable incremental value is found, make diagnostic-only or structurally eliminate rather than assigning precise weights.

findings.current_basis: hand-set uncertainty blend and pair capture/cap mechanics retained as diagnostic context; incremental acceptance shift disabled
findings.key_issue: canonical Simulator lineup reoptimization and availability sampling already capture much of the roster-insurance concept
findings.promotion_evidence: Incremental simulation or historical evidence beyond canonical replacement-resilience effects.

findings.current_basis: multiple hand-set curves used to improve candidate recall rather than final economic scoring
findings.key_issue: a search heuristic can still create omission bias even when it has no final utility vote
findings.promotion_evidence: Search-recall benchmark against exhaustive tractable package spaces plus frozen contemporaneous transaction/value evidence.

findings.current_basis: hand-selected computational precision budgets with common random numbers for comparisons
findings.key_issue: should be governed by convergence and decision-stability error rather than treated as model calibration
findings.promotion_evidence: Convergence curves for expected wins/playoff/title estimates and decision rank/sign stability versus simulation count.

do_not_change_yet: Shared Decision Utility median current-outcome aggregator
reason: Each requires either independent historical targets, residual forecast archives, exhaustive recall benchmarks, or convergence evidence before a production change is justified.
